newsitem.title: JAPAN: Biwako Bank says not suffering financial problems.
newsitem.headline: Biwako Bank says not suffering financial problems.

text.p: Biwako Bank Ltd, a Japanese regional bank, said on Wednesday that it is not suffering from financial problems.
Asked about vague market talk that it may be facing difficulties, a Biwako Bank official told Reuters: "The rumours in the market are groundless."
Shares in Biwako Bank were sharply lower in morning trade on Wednesday amid thin trade, brokers said.

There were vague market rumours that the bank was suffering from losses stemming from foreign exchange transactions, or the bank was lending money to non-bank financial institutions which had extended loans to Osaka-based realtor Sueno Kosan, a major borrower of funds from failed "jusen" mortgage companies.

Another rumour also said that the bank was planning to hold a news conference on its financial condition. The bank official said the rumours were all false, adding that the bank had not lent money to Sueno or Sueno-related companies.
The bank's shares traded at 491 yen at 0152 GMT on Wednesday. They closed on Monday at 549 yen. The share was untraded on Tuesday.
